title: Program Manager & Head of Knowledge (Analytical Systems, Evaluation & AI Enablement)
companyOverview: Die Humanis AG ist seit 1986 im Bereich Management- und Spezialistenselektion tätig. Die konsequente strategische Ausrichtung auf Kompetenzfelder gewährt Kunden und Kandidaten Effizienz und garantiert hohe Sachkenntnisse der Berater. Diese verfügen über fundierte Führungspraxis in jenen Branchen und Berufsgebieten, in denen sie Kandidaten für ihre Kunden rekrutieren. Dies erlaubt die Besetzung von höchst anspruchsvollen Positionen, bei denen die traditionellen Rekrutierungsmethoden oft nicht zum Ziel führen. Humanis beschäftigt rund 30 Mitarbeitende, von denen über zwei Drittel als ausgewiesene, erfahrene Consultants tätig sind. Die Humanis AG ist in der Schweiz eine der führenden Personalberatungen.
category: Technisch / Informatik / Telekommunikation / Datenbank Spezialisten / Entwicklung
description:
This role sits at the center of the organization’s knowledge, evaluation, and analytical infrastructure. It combines program management, methodological leadership, statistical modelling, and AI?enabled knowledge work. The position ensures that evaluation systems, research processes, and knowledge platforms are robust, evidence?driven, and operationally reliable. It acts as a key interface between program teams, leadership, external experts, and research partners, translating complex analytical work into actionable insights for decision?makers.

Program Manager & Head of Knowledge (Analytical Systems, Evaluation & AI Enablement)
Ihre Aufgaben

- Central analytical role at the intersection of evaluation, knowledge management, and program delivery

- Methodological lead for Bayesian modelling, causal inference, and statistical documentation

- Coordinator of multi?stream evaluation portfolios, including EXPECT, PROOF, and ENJOY

- Bridge between programs and evidence, translating analytical outputs into actionable insights

- Manager of external experts and research implementers, ensuring quality and alignment

- Owner of knowledge systems, including feature prioritization, release planning, and documentation

- AI enablement focal point, supporting adoption, governance, and tool literacy across teams

- Contributor to applied research, ensuring methodological rigor and relevance

- Continuity provider for leadership roles, maintaining operational stability during absences

- Strong communicator, able to engage leadership, program teams, and external partners effectively


Ihr Profil

- Advanced analytical skills in Bayesian modelling, causal inference, and quantitative evaluation

- Experience designing expert?elicitation protocols and maintaining complex historical datasets

- Ability to produce high?quality statistical outputs, including estimations and technical documentation

- Strong program and research management capabilities, including RFPs, contracting, and cost modelling

- Competence in survey and measurement design, ensuring methodological soundness and usability

- Hands?on AI literacy, with the ability to onboard colleagues and maintain governance standards

- Applied research experience, contributing credible analysis and drafting for research tracks

- Operational reliability, ensuring continuity of systems, reporting, and cross?workstream coordination

- Stakeholder management strength, working confidently with leadership, program teams, and external experts

- Clear, structured communication, able to translate complex analytical work into accessible insights
